title: Confidence
description: Calibrated confidence score for the reconstruction, plus the raw components it was computed from (see Section 3 of the project design: confidence = alpha*cos_sim + beta*retrieval_margin + gamma*component_agreement, then temperature-scaled).

score.description: Final calibrated confidence in [0, 1]. Not a claim of exact-recovery probability - see docs/api-contract.md.

cos_sim.description: Reconstruction consistency: cosine similarity between the input embedding and the re-embedded regeneration. Null if regeneration (Task 6.1) was skipped/feature-flagged off.

retrieval_margin.description: Distance/similarity gap between the top-1 and top-2 retrieved candidates.

component_agreement.description: Overlap between the decomposition model's structured fields and the PEZ baseline output.

weights.description: The alpha/beta/gamma weights used for this score (fitted via Task 6.3, temperature-scaled). Null before calibration is wired in.
